name: Zone Notes
summary: Write your own reminders for any zone and get them back the moment you arrive there again, on every character.
logoPrompt: A small folded paper map with a red pushpin holding a yellow sticky note on top of it

cover.tagline: Your notes, waiting in every zone.
bullets: Notes per zone, typed in chat

description: **Zone Notes lets you write short notes for the zone you are in and shows them again each time you enter that zone.**
- Add a note for the current zone with one chat command.
- Your notes appear in chat when you arrive in the zone.
- A small window lists them too. Drag it anywhere or close it with a right-click.
- A list of every zone that has notes.
- Notes are shared by all characters on your account.

Type `/zn add` followed by your text, for example `/zn add Herbs behind the inn`. `/zn` shows the notes of this zone and all commands, `/zn remove 2` deletes the second note, `/zn all` lists your zones, `/zn popup off` keeps the window closed and `/zn quiet on` turns off the chat lines.
- Up to 10 notes per zone, 200 characters each.
- Caves and buildings count as the zone around them.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
